setsid --fork --wait nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool held-pair-exterior-compare --memory-gib 1 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/held_pair_exterior_compare01 -- python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path

root=Path('"'"'_scratch/s11c'"'"')
m=json.loads(Path('"'"'docs/_measurements/lateral_reservoir_pair.json'"'"').read_text())
references={}
old,=[r for r in m['"'"'runs'"'"'] if '"'"'lateral_reservoir_readout.py'"'"' in r['"'"'command'"'"']]
for line in old['"'"'stdout'"'"']:
    if line.startswith('"'"'extent='"'"'):
        grid=dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in line.split())
        key=(round(float(grid['"'"'extent'"'"'])),round(1/float(grid['"'"'dx'"'"'])))
    elif line.lstrip().startswith(('"'"'d=4 carried='"'"','"'"'d=8 carried='"'"')):
        row=dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in line.split())
        references[key,int(row['"'"'d'"'"'])]=float(row['"'"'total'"'"'])
for L,c in [(12,4),(24,4),(24,6),(36,4),(48,4)]:
    folder=root/f'"'"'held_pair_exterior_e{L}_c{c}_01'"'"'
    result=json.loads((folder/'"'"'outcome.json'"'"').read_text())
    if not result['"'"'limitsVerified'"'"'] or result['"'"'exitCode'"'"'] or result['"'"'childOutcome'"'"']['"'"'exitCode'"'"']:
        raise ValueError(f'"'"'Failed guard or worker at {folder}'"'"')
    data=[dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in line.split()) for line in (folder/'"'"'stdout'"'"').read_text().splitlines()]
    for d in (4,8):
        prior=references[(L,c),d]
        prep,=[v for v in data if v.get('"'"'d'"'"')==str(d) and '"'"'mouth'"'"' in v]
        if abs(float(prep['"'"'mouth'"'"'])-prior)>2e-14:
            raise ArithmeticError('"'"'Mouth comparator differs from previously recorded pair-minus-alone load'"'"')
        v4=[v for v in data if v.get('"'"'d'"'"')==str(d) and v.get('"'"'order'"'"')=='"'"'4'"'"']
        tf=[v for v in data if v.get('"'"'d'"'"')==str(d) and '"'"'tensor'"'"' in v]
        a,=[float(v['"'"'outer'"'"']) for v in v4 if v['"'"'R'"'"']=='"'"'2'"'"']
        b,=[float(v['"'"'tensor'"'"']) for v in tf if v['"'"'R'"'"']=='"'"'2'"'"']
        print(f'"'"'extent={L} cells={c} d={d} R=2 outer={a:.12g} tensor={b:.12g} prior_mouth={prior:.12g} '"'"'
              f'"'"'outer_vs_mouth_percent={100*(a/prior-1):.12g} tensor_vs_mouth_percent={100*(b/prior-1):.12g}'"'"')
    ratios=[v for v in data if '"'"'ratio_outer'"'"' in v]
    main,=[v for v in ratios if v['"'"'R'"'"']=='"'"'2'"'"']
    closure=max(abs(float(v['"'"'closure'"'"'])) for v in data if '"'"'closure'"'"' in v)
    withheld=max(float(v['"'"'withheld'"'"']) for v in data if '"'"'withheld'"'"' in v)
    outers=[float(v['"'"'ratio_outer'"'"']) for v in ratios]
    tensors=[float(v['"'"'ratio_tensor'"'"']) for v in ratios]
    print(f"extent={L} cells={c} R=2 outer8_over_4={main['"'"'ratio_outer'"'"']} tensor8_over_4={main['"'"'ratio_tensor'"'"']} "
          f"mouth8_over_4={main['"'"'ratio_mouth'"'"']} percent_from_quarter={main['"'"'outer_percent_from_quarter'"'"']} "
          f"outer_ratio_min={min(outers):.12g} outer_ratio_max={max(outers):.12g} "
          f"tensor_ratio_min={min(tensors):.12g} tensor_ratio_max={max(tensors):.12g} "
          f"max_closure={closure:.12g} max_withheld={withheld:.12g}")
'
